context: Ren and Mei chat about a recipe they tried.
purpose: Casual register; adverbs (どうしても/そういった/とりあえず/きちんと/通常) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日の料理、どうしてもうまくいかなくて。
lines.en: Yesterday's cooking just wouldn't turn out.
lines.style: soft rueful woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そういった時は、火加減かもね。
lines.en: In those cases, it might be the heat.
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 通常のレシピ通りに、作ったのに。
lines.en: I made it exactly per the usual recipe.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm puzzled delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: とりあえず、もう一度試してみよう。
lines.en: For now, let's try once more.
lines.style: encouraging young man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 次は、きちんと量を計るね。
lines.style: soft determined woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そういった工夫で、きっと変わるよ。
lines.en: With that kind of effort, it'll surely change.
lines.style: warm young man voice, soft warm reassuring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: どうしても、おいしく作りたいの。
lines.en: I really want to make it delicious.
lines.style: earnest woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: とりあえず、一緒に作ってみようよ。
lines.en: For now, let's make it together.
lines.style: gentle young man voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
